description: This file defines the SocketConnectionListener class which manages socket listening, accepting connections, and clean-up in a networking context for Orleans. It handles socket creation, binding, listening, accepting incoming connections asynchronously, and proper disposal.

classes.name: SocketConnectionListener
classes.description: Sealed class implementing IConnectionListener to manage socket listening, accepting connections, and cleanup within Orleans networking.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Initializes and binds a listening socket to the specified endpoint with appropriate socket options, including IPv6/IPv4 handling.

methods.name: AcceptAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously accepts an incoming socket connection, configures it, and wraps it in a SocketConnection object.

methods.name: UnbindAsync
methods.description: Disposes the listening socket to unbind from the endpoint.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Async disposal of the listening socket and memory pool to release resources.
